headline: Recognition marks plus a contact gate wall clades apart (11 to 43 separate pieces vs 1 connected mat) but not bodies; the pieces are clade patches made by a lottery of foreign-mark buds and they freeze once the world is full.

The one-component-vs-many contrast is true by construction (the tag-blind control is the plain mat; its big mark-patch count is sometimes higher and sometimes lower than the gated run, depending on seed); body-scale measures get worse under the gate (basin median about 77 to 100 vs about 173 in control).
No arm reached turnover with discrete bodies: rung 3 appears only as border churn (about 10x control, two-way) or a jammed mosaic.
